title: Schauder-type Estimates and Log-Critical Well-posedness for the Two-Phase Muskat Problem with Surface Tension
summary: We prove short-time well-posedness for the Muskat problem with surface tension in the full two-phase setting, allowing different viscosities, arbitrary density contrast, and rigid boundaries. In particular, no Rayleigh--Taylor sign condition on the density contrast is imposed. The interface is assumed to be a graph, uniformly separated from the fixed boundaries, and the initial data may be large in the log-critical class $\dot C^{1,\log^\varkappa}\cap H^1$, with $\varkappa>1$.
